title: External tool registry
description: Validates the dict that tomllib.load returns for registries/tools.toml: external programs gbf calls (FFmpeg, Git, uv, Python). Tools are installed by the user and never bundled with the repository or its releases. Dates are quoted 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Licence facts are engineering judgements, not legal advice.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier: letters and digits in groups joined by '-' or '.'.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL in printable ASCII without spaces.

license.description: SPDX licence expression or LicenseRef-* id.

executables.description: Program names that must be found on PATH (or, for the interpreter, inside the virtualenv).

required_for.description: runtime: pipeline commands. tests: the test suite and the gate. setup: creating the environment. receipts: provenance written into receipts.

license.description: Licence of the upstream project as usually distributed.

license_note.description: How builds differ (for example GPL FFmpeg builds) and what that means for distribution.

bundled.description: Always false: external tools are never bundled or redistributed by gbf.

version_spec.description: PEP 440-style specifier the version must satisfy, or 'any' when no minimum has been established.

tested_version.description: Version used when this entry was verified.

runtime_check.description: enforced: commands refuse to run outside version_spec. recorded: the version found is written into receipts. not_checked: setup-only tool.
